chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority/power) is conditional upon human free will, applying specifically to those who voluntarily submit to his whispers rather than being forced. This distinction refutes the notion of absolute predestination regarding sin, emphasizing that believers retain the agency to resist, thereby establishing a theological basis for moral responsibility and the possibility of spiritual victory over the ego and the devil.
